about_the_game:
🦾 Overcome obstacles and push your limits!

Embark on an electrifying 3D platformer where you control a wheelchair-bound character through intense and dynamic challenges. This offline singleplayer game puts your skills to the test in levels filled with unpredictable obstacles.

🔥 Key Features:

  • Fluid and dynamic movement → Full control of the wheelchair, including jumps and precise maneuvers.

  • Challenging levels → Each stage brings new obstacles, requiring agility and strategy to progress.

  • Unique progression mechanic → Made a mistake? Go back to the previous level and try again!

  • Dynamic obstacles → Moving platforms, steep ramps, slippery areas, and much more.

  • Stylized and vibrant art → A low-poly visual style that enhances the creativity of each challenge.

  • Play at your own pace → No internet connection required.

  • Score system → Get your final score and compare it with your friends. Who will be the best?

If you enjoy skill-based and precision games where every move counts, this is the perfect challenge for you! 🚀
